coverage_notes: The document identifies itself as a modified Apache License 2.0 and incorporates other Apache License 2.0 rights and restrictions by reference. The referenced license text is not supplied, so its operative permissions and restrictions cannot be extracted.
The commercial-use introduction does not clearly establish whether the branding and certificate-system requirements apply to all commercial use or only to uses requiring a commercial license.

The contributor paragraph also states that Infinite Wisdom Software may adjust the open-source agreement to be more strict or relaxed. The text does not specify the scope or mechanism of that adjustment, so its operative effect remains unresolved.
